description: Find restaurants, cafes, bars, entertainment, leisure and wellness venues in Malaysia by words and filters. Use it when the user wants options in a place (neighbourhood, city or near a landmark), a cuisine, a certified-halal requirement, menu-checked dietary needs (no pork / no alcohol on the menu), a price band, or places open right now. Use the filters, not free text, for needs: set no_pork_menu / no_alcohol_menu rather than typing 'no pork' (free text matches menus that mention pork); set venue_type=dining for a meal (lunch, dinner, a date) so cafés, dessert bars and bars are not returned, and venue_type=cafe or bar when those are wanted. City names accept the usual short forms (KL, PJ, JB, Penang). Returns up to 20 compact cards with a rating (from Google reviews), price level 1–4 (with price_level_source: type_estimate when it is estimated from the venue type, not a known price), a price_range (a per-person spend when source is google = reported by reviewers, owner or admin = entered by the venue or Festiv staff, menu_estimate = estimated from the menu; source menu = the spread of menu item prices, a weaker signal), cuisines, the venue's address and coordinates (for a map), `halal_certified` only when a halal certificate is on record, a `dietary` block with menu observations and their provenance note, `nearby: true` for venues just outside the named neighbourhood, open-now status and a link to the Festiv page. Only `halal_certified: true` means a venue is halal; a `dietary` note is a menu observation, not a halal status of any kind.

area.description: Neighbourhood or district name, e.g. 'Bangsar', 'KLCC', 'George Town'. A name Festiv does not know is refused, not guessed; a city or region word such as 'Penang' or 'Klang Valley' is read as a city.
area.title: Area

city.description: City when no neighbourhood is known, e.g. 'Kuala Lumpur', 'Petaling Jaya', 'Penang'.
city.title: City

halal.description: True = only venues with a verified halal certificate on record (few venues; for dietary needs prefer no_pork_menu / no_alcohol_menu).
halal.title: Halal

language.description: Reply language for summaries: en, ms (Malay) or zh (Chinese). Venue names stay in their original script.
language.title: Language

max_price_per_person.description: Budget in ringgit per person, e.g. 20 for 'under RM20'; only venues with a known per-person price at or below it qualify.
max_price_per_person.title: Max Price Per Person

near.description: A mall, hotel or attraction name to search within 1.5 km of, e.g. 'Pavilion KL', 'Suria KLCC', 'Mid Valley Megamall'. Unknown names are refused (use area or city instead). Coordinates are not accepted.
near.title: Near

no_alcohol_menu.description: True = only venues whose published menu was checked and lists no alcohol (a menu observation, not a halal status).
no_alcohol_menu.title: No Alcohol Menu

no_pork_menu.description: True = only venues whose published menu was checked and lists no pork (a menu observation, not a halal status).
no_pork_menu.title: No Pork Menu

open_now.description: True = open at this moment in Malaysia time.
open_now.title: Open Now

query.description: Free words: a venue name, dish, cuisine or vibe, e.g. 'omakase', 'rooftop cocktails'.
query.title: Query

venue_type.description: One of dining, cafe, bar, entertainment, leisure, wellness, mall.
venue_type.title: Venue Type

name: search_venues
title: Search venues in Malaysia
